results.releaseNotes: New Game: Parties! It’s party time in Toca Boca Jr, and you’re invited! Host a tea party or throw a birthday bash in a new game that’s even better with friends. Set the table, share snacks, unwrap your presents, and make sure to save room for cake. There’s always something to celebrate!
results.description:
FAN-FAVORITE GAMES 
Discover the best games for kids ages 2-8, trusted by over 100 million families! Toca Boca Jr is full of imaginative ways for kids to play, create, build worlds, and explore. Bringing together Toca Boca’s most-loved games in one app, kids boost problem-solving skills, explore self-expression, and spark interests through the power of play. 

TOCA BOCA DANCE 
Dress up, get down, and bust a move in Toca Boca Dance! Form a squad, pick out costumes, set the stage, and make music videos to share with friends.

TOCA BOCA KITCHEN 2
Looking for the most-loved cooking games? Create, cook, and serve all sorts of tasty (and not-so-tasty) food in Toca Boca Kitchen 2 to some hungry characters and see what they like. Cooking games for kids are perfect for unleashing creativity!

TOCA BOCA PET DOCTOR
Kids take care of 25 pets of all shapes and sizes! From a turtle flipped over on its shell to a dinosaur with a stomach bug, there are lots of animals to rescue. Toca Pet Doctor has the best animal games for kids!

TOCA BOCA PARTIES
It's party time! Set the table, share some sweet treats, and celebrate with friends in fan-favorite games Toca Tea Party and Toca Birthday.

TOCA BOCA NATURE 
Foster a love of the great outdoors! Kids create their own world, shape nature, and watch the animal games begin. 

TOCA BOCA CARS
Start your engines! Kids get behind the wheel in Toca Boca Jr’s newest car game, driving tons of vehicles and building their own streets.

TOCA BOCA LAB: ELEMENTS
Unlock a passion for early STEM learning! Kids explore the electrifying world of science, run their own experiments, and discover all 118 of the elements from the periodic table.

TOCA BOCA BUILDERS, AND MORE! 
Kids join six unique builder buddies and create a whole new world with blocks. Spark creativity in this building game!

SUBSCRIPTION BENEFITS
Toca Boca Jr is part of Piknik – the best kids apps in one subscription! Get full access to a bundle of the world's best games for kids from award-winning studios Toca Boca (creators of Toca Boca World), Sago Mini, and Originator for one low monthly price.

• Includes Kitchen 2, Dance, Kitchen Sushi, Pet Doctor, Builders, Boo, Mini, Cars, Band, Train, Lab: Elements, Lab: Plants, Blocks, Nature & Mystery House
• Play downloaded games offline without WiFi or internet
• Try before you buy! Download the Toca Boca Jr app to start your free trial
• COPPA and kidSAFE certified – safe and secure screen time for kids
• Use one subscription across multiple devices for easy access to award-winning games for kids
• No third-party advertising or in-app purchases
• Cancel Toca Boca Jr anytime with no hassle

Privacy Policy

All of Toca Boca’s products are COPPA-compliant. We take privacy very seriously, and we’re committed to providing safe and secure apps for kids that parents can trust. To learn more about how Tocaboca designs and maintains safe games for kids, please read our:

Privacy policy: https://playpiknik.link/privacy-policy
Terms of use: https://playpiknik.link/terms-of-use

About Toca Boca

Toca Boca is the award-winning game studio behind Toca Life World and Toca Hair Salon 4. We design digital toys for kids that stimulate the imagination – all in a safe way without third-party advertising, trusted by millions of parents around the world.
